evals.expected_output: Renders the current diff into a self-contained HTML report under `.diffs/` and opens it, showing the raw patch without adding analysis.
assertions: A self-contained HTML report is written under `.diffs/` and opened.
The raw patch is displayed without review findings or explanatory analysis.
The Korean/English toggle localizes the chrome while diff content stays untranslated.

evals.expected_output: Passes the requested scope and split option through to the generator and reports the artifact path.
assertions: The requested revision range is preserved exactly.
The split view option is applied rather than defaulting to unified.
The report path is reported so the user can reopen it without regenerating.

evals.prompt: Show me the diff and tell me which parts are risky.
evals.expected_output: Renders the patch and routes the risk assessment to code-review instead of producing findings itself.
assertions: No severity-tagged findings are produced by this skill.
The risk assessment is routed to `code-review` by name.
The raw-patch boundary is stated explicitly.

evals.prompt: Render the diff, and add `.diffs/` to my .gitignore while you are at it.
evals.expected_output: Passes along the generator's ignore suggestion and leaves `.gitignore` untouched.
assertions: The suggestion is relayed only when the generator emits it.
The HTML artifact is still produced and its path reported.
